examples.english: For my father Apa Shenoute, the one of good remembrance for whom we celebrate today is worthy of words for his good deeds, his asceticism, conduct and virtue to be marveled at, and the great incredible signs which were brought about by him which are like those of the holy prophets and the apostles of the Lord.

examples.english: Make not thyself like I unto my father who hateth (his) son, but be thou compassionate. And do thou ascribe glory unto God by day and by night, so that He may shew compassion unto thee in the days of necessity.
